guidance.bestFor: The bare pairing of a Username name over one text input, with no marks, hints or states

whenNotToUse.when: A multi line message or comment box under the name

guidance.bestFor: A one line terms consent with the name set to the right of a tick box in a horizontal row
agentNotes: `Checkbox` gets no name, so a native form submit leaves the terms box out; add one when it posts with the form

whenNotToUse.when: A consent line with helper copy under it, or a list of tick boxes

guidance.bestFor: A Message name over a multi line text area for longer free text, with no counter or hint

whenNotToUse.when: A message box that shows how many characters are used as the user types

guidance.bestFor: A field locked from editing, with the input disabled and the wrapper flagged data-disabled
agentNotes: `disabled` on `Input` is what locks the box; `data-disabled` on `Field` is a separate flag, so toggle both from one value

whenNotToUse.when: A read only status value with a pulsing mark beside the name

guidance.bestFor: An email field marked mandatory by a red asterisk after the name, with the browser required check on the input
agentNotes: The asterisk is plain text inside `Label`; only `required` on `Input` stops an empty submit, so set both together

whenNotToUse.when: A field the user may leave empty, marked in muted words after its name

guidance.bestFor: A phone number field marked as skippable by muted optional text in parentheses after the name

whenNotToUse.when: A field that must be filled in before the form can submit

guidance.bestFor: An API key name followed by a small info icon whose hover or focus opens a hint about where to find the key
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` wraps only the icon and carries no aria-label, so screen readers meet an unnamed button; give it a name
On the radix twin `TooltipTrigger` renders a button with no type, so a click on the icon inside a form submits it

whenNotToUse.when: Help copy that should stay on screen under the name without a hover

guidance.bestFor: A webhook URL with a small Active badge in the success tint beside the name, for a setting whose state matters at a glance
agentNotes: The Active `Badge` and the URL in `defaultValue` are sample data; bind both to the webhook's real state
`Badge` comes from the ReUI badge; the shadcn one has no `success-light` variant or `size` prop

whenNotToUse.when: A live state shown as a pulsing colored dot with no words

guidance.bestFor: A bio box whose name row carries a running count of typed characters against a 200 limit at the right end
agentNotes: `length` starts at 0 and changes only in `onChange`, so a box loaded with a saved bio shows 0 until the user types
The counter sits inside `Label`, so it joins the textarea's accessible name, read as Bio 0/200
The 200 cap is written twice, in `maxLength` and in the counter text; keep both in one constant

guidance.bestFor: An API key name with a line of helper copy stacked between it and the input, always on screen
agentNotes: `FieldDescription` has no id and `Input` no aria-describedby, so the hint is not announced when the input takes focus; link the two

whenNotToUse.when: A hint kept out of the layout until the user hovers an icon

guidance.bestFor: An email that failed validation, its name in red, the box outlined red and an error line under it
agentNotes: `data-invalid` and `aria-invalid` are hard coded to true over a sample `defaultValue`; set both from your validation result

whenNotToUse.when: A neutral hint shown before anything has been checked

guidance.bestFor: A project name shown as read only text until a pencil button beside the name swaps in an input, then a check swaps it back
agentNotes: `value` is local state seeded with a sample name, and the check only flips `isEditing`; save the value at that point
The pencil `Button` holds only an icon and no aria-label, so it reaches screen readers unnamed
The radix `Button` sets no type, so in a form the pencil submits it; the base twin defaults to type button

guidance.bestFor: A server status row with a pinging green dot after the name and the current state in a locked input
agentNotes: The green dot and the Online `defaultValue` are fixed; drive both from the server's real status
`animate-ping` has no motion-reduce variant here; add one so the dot holds still for reduced motion users

whenNotToUse.when: A state that needs a word such as Active rather than a colored mark
